why: The book's own plane-wave DFT (js/pw.js: local exchange, its own Troullier–Martins pseudopotentials) on the four alumina structures PBE has ranked (corundum lowest; impostor +0.15, poly6 +0.38, θ +0.50 eV per formula): the 3D check before it scores Bl₂Px₃. Same cells, same scales, ecut 40, k shifted ~18 bohr.
